_readme: Copy to config/models.json and replace every value with your own VERIFIED evidence. The provider ids, model ids and prices below are placeholders chosen to show the shape, not a recommended routing table. Never copy a price or a probe result you did not observe yourself: the whole point of this file is that its contents were checked. docs/configuration.md owns the schema; .agents/skills/model-onboarding/SKILL.md owns the admission policy.

example-apikey._note: One key here reaches BOTH free and metered models, which is why the allowlist below is by exact model id and never by provider.

example-metered.status_reason: no qualifying free tier; rejected by cost policy

example-apikey/free-model._note: An API-key model must ALSO appear in zero_budget.allowlist below. Presence here is a description; presence there is the authorization.

example-subscription/withdrawn-model._note: Record a refusal and its evidence so it is never rediscovered as a plausible-looking name.
example-subscription/withdrawn-model.status_reason: live probe returned a server-side entitlement refusal for this account type

zero_budget._rule: API-key providers route ONLY to models listed here, by exact id. Never to a provider generally, never to a provider default, and never to an unlisted sibling during failover. Adding an entry requires evidence the model is free.

example-apikey/free-model.hard_ceiling: provider-side quota override refuses requests past the limit rather than billing them

observation._note: How stale probe evidence may become before it is reported. This is what keeps the session-start sweep interval-gated instead of probing every model every time.

promotion._note: Dormant until BOTH enabled is true and the named instrument produces records. Every threshold is configuration; firstmate must name the value it acted on when it explains a promotion. These numbers are bootstrap defaults to tune from real history, not measurements.

authority._note: Validated as a ceiling: a home may be more conservative, never more permissive. Tier 1 is triggered by RISK rather than capability rank, so no accumulation of evidence may enter it.

demotion._note: Deliberately faster than promotion, because reasoning quality must never silently degrade. Evidence resets to zero rather than decaying so a marginal model cannot oscillate across the threshold.
